texts.NIV84: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:
texts.KJV: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
texts.NKJV: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:
texts.DRB: The parables of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel.

texts.NIV84: for attaining wisdom and discipline; for understanding words of insight;
texts.KJV: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
texts.NKJV:
To know wisdom and instruction,
To perceive the words of understanding,
texts.DRB: To know wisdom, and instruction: To understand the words of prudence:

texts.NIV84: for acquiring a disciplined and prudent life, doing what is right and just and fair;
texts.KJV: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
texts.NKJV:
To receive the instruction of wisdom,
Justice, judgment, and equity;
texts.DRB: and to receive the instruction of doctrine, justice, and judgment, and equity:

texts.NIV84: for giving prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young-
texts.KJV: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
texts.NKJV:
To give prudence to the simple,
To the young man knowledge and discretion—
texts.DRB: To give subtilty to little ones, to the young man knowledge and understanding.

texts.NIV84: let the wise listen and add to their learning, and let the discerning get guidance-
texts.KJV: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
texts.NKJV:
A wise man will hear and increase learning,
And a man of understanding will attain wise counsel,
texts.DRB: A wise man shall hear and shall be wiser: and he that understandeth, shall possess governments.

texts.NIV84: for understanding proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.
texts.KJV: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
texts.NKJV:
To understand a proverb and an enigma,
The words of the wise and their riddles.
texts.DRB: He shall understand a parable, and the interpretation, the words of the wise, and their mysterious sayings.

texts.NIV84: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
texts.KJV: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
texts.NKJV:
The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge,
But fools despise wisdom and instruction.
texts.DRB: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom. Fools despise wisdom and instruction.

texts.NIV84: Listen, my son, to your father's instruction and do not forsake your mother's teaching.
texts.KJV: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
texts.NKJV:
My son, hear the instruction of your father,
And do not forsake the law of your mother;
texts.DRB: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother :

texts.NIV84: They will be a garland to grace your head and a chain to adorn your neck.
texts.KJV: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
texts.NKJV:
For they will be a graceful ornament on your head,
And chains about your neck.
texts.DRB: That grace may be added to thy head, and a chain of gold to thy neck.

texts.NIV84: My son, if sinners entice you, do not give in to them.
texts.KJV: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
texts.NKJV:
My son, if sinners entice you,
Do not consent.
texts.DRB: My son, if sinners shall entice thee, consent not to them.

texts.NIV84: If they say, "Come along with us; let's lie in wait for someone's blood, let's waylay some harmless soul;
texts.KJV: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
texts.DRB: If they shall say: Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood, let us hide snares for the innocent without cause:

texts.NIV84: let's swallow them alive, like the grave, and whole, like those who go down to the pit;
texts.KJV: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
texts.NKJV:
Let us swallow them alive like Sheol,
And whole, like those who go down to the Pit;
texts.DRB: Let us swallow him up alive like hell, and whole as one that goeth down into the pit.

texts.NIV84: we will get all sorts of valuable things and fill our houses with plunder;
texts.KJV: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
texts.NKJV:
We shall find all kinds of precious possessions,
We shall fill our houses with spoil;
texts.DRB: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoils.

texts.NIV84: throw in your lot with us, and we will share a common purse"-
texts.KJV: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
texts.NKJV:
Cast in your lot among us,
Let us all have one purse”—
texts.DRB: Cast in thy lot with us, let us all have one purse.

texts.NIV84: my son, do not go along with them, do not set foot on their paths;
texts.KJV: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
texts.NKJV:
My son, do not walk in the way with them,
Keep your foot from their path;
texts.DRB: My son, walk not thou with them, restrain thy foot from their paths.

texts.NIV84: for their feet rush into sin, they are swift to shed blood.
texts.KJV: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
texts.NKJV:
For their feet run to evil,
And they make haste to shed blood.
texts.DRB: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

texts.NIV84: How useless to spread a net in full view of all the birds!
texts.KJV: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
texts.NKJV:
Surely, in vain the net is spread
In the sight of any bird;
texts.DRB: But a net is spread in vain before the eyes of them that have wings.

texts.NIV84: These men lie in wait for their own blood; they waylay only themselves!
texts.KJV: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
texts.NKJV:
But they lie in wait for their own blood,
They lurk secretly for their own lives.
texts.DRB: And they themselves lie in wait for their own blood, and practise deceits against their own souls.

texts.NIV84: Such is the end of all who go after ill-gotten gain; it takes away the lives of those who get it.
texts.KJV: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
texts.NKJV:
So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain;
It takes away the life of its owners.
texts.DRB: So the wage of every covetous man destroy the souls of the possessors.

texts.NIV84: Wisdom calls aloud in the street, she raises her voice in the public squares;
texts.KJV: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
texts.NKJV:
Wisdom calls aloud outside;
She raises her voice in the open squares.
texts.DRB: Wisdom preacheth abroad, she uttereth her voice in the streets:

texts.NIV84: at the head of the noisy streets she cries out, in the gateways of the city she makes her speech:
texts.KJV: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
texts.NKJV:
She cries out in the chief concourses,
At the openings of the gates in the city
She speaks her words:
texts.DRB: At the head of multitudes she crieth out, in the entrance of the gates of the city she uttereth her words, saying:

texts.NIV84: "How long will you simple ones love your simple ways? How long will mockers delight in mockery and fools hate knowledge?
texts.KJV: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
texts.NKJV:
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity?
For scorners delight in their scorning,
And fools hate knowledge.
texts.DRB: O children, how long will you love childishness, and fools covet those things which are hurtful to themselves, and the unwise hate knowledge?

texts.NIV84: If you had responded to my rebuke, I would have poured out my heart to you and made my thoughts known to you.
texts.KJV: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
texts.DRB: Turn ye at my reproof: behold I will utter my spirit to you, and will shew you my words.

texts.NIV84: But since you rejected me when I called and no one gave heed when I stretched out my hand,
texts.KJV: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
texts.NKJV:
Because I have called and you refused,
I have stretched out my hand and no one regarded,
texts.DRB: Because I called, and you refused: I stretched out my hand, and there was none that regarded.

texts.NIV84: since you ignored all my advice and would not accept my rebuke,
texts.KJV: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
texts.NKJV:
Because you disdained all my counsel,
And would have none of my rebuke,
texts.DRB: You have despised all my counsel, and have neglected my reprehensions.

texts.NIV84: I in turn will laugh at your disaster; I will mock when calamity overtakes you-
texts.KJV: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
texts.NKJV:
I also will laugh at your calamity;
I will mock when your terror comes,
texts.DRB: I also will laugh in your destruction, and will mock when that shall come to you which you feared.

texts.NIV84: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster sweeps over you like a whirlwind, when distress and trouble overwhelm you.
texts.KJV: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
texts.NKJV:
When your terror comes like a storm,
And your destruction comes like a whirlwind,
When distress and anguish come upon you.
texts.DRB: When sudden calamity shall fall on you, and destruction, as a tempest, shall be at hand: when tribulation and distress shall come upon you:

texts.NIV84: "Then they will call to me but I will not answer; they will look for me but will not find me.
texts.KJV: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
texts.NKJV:
“Then they will call on me, but I will not answer;
They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me.
texts.DRB: Then shall they call upon me, and I will not hear: they shall rise in the morning and shall not find me:

texts.NIV84: Since they hated knowledge and did not choose to fear the LORD,
texts.KJV: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the Lord:
texts.NKJV:
Because they hated knowledge
And did not choose the fear of the Lord,
texts.DRB: Because they have hated instruction and received not the fear of the Lord,

texts.NIV84: since they would not accept my advice and spurned my rebuke,
texts.KJV: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
texts.NKJV:
They would have none of my counsel
And despised my every rebuke.
texts.DRB: Nor consented to my counsel, but despised all my reproof.

texts.NIV84: they will eat the fruit of their ways and be filled with the fruit of their schemes.
texts.KJV: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
texts.NKJV:
Therefore they shall eat the fruit of their own way,
And be filled to the full with their own fancies.
texts.DRB: Therefore they shall eat the fruit of their own way, and shall be filled with their own devices.

texts.NIV84: For the waywardness of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them;
texts.KJV: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
texts.NKJV:
For the turning away of the simple will slay them,
And the complacency of fools will destroy them;
texts.DRB: The turning away of little ones shall kill them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

texts.NIV84: but whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm."
texts.KJV: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
texts.NKJV:
But whoever listens to me will dwell safely,
And will be secure, without fear of evil.”
texts.DRB: But he that shall hear me, shall rest without terror, and shall enjoy abundance, without fear of evils.
